prompt:
Subject: inactive, target meaning "不活発な".

Composition: A worker sits motionless beside an idle machine with its wheel stopped and tools untouched, making the lack of activity visible without suggesting permanent inability.

Style: Use references/invidious.png for style only: thick rounded dark-brown outlines, simplified rounded 2D shapes, restrained cartoon shading.

Framing: One compact composition filling 80–90% of the square; keep all subjects complete. No decorative frame, pedestal, or floating ornaments.

Output: 512×512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background and gaps. No text, letters, numerals, speech bubbles, labels, branding, or watermark.
Style reference invidious.png only: friendly rounded 2D cartoon, thick dark-brown outlines, flat color, restrained shading. A switched-off machine rests quietly with its power lever down while a person waits beside it, showing that it is idle.
en: The machine is inactive while the person waits beside it.
ja: 人がそばで待つ間、機械は停止していて不活発です。
